title: Visual appearance of websites

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Adapt a broad identity to a website’s needs so recurring public information remains recognizable and readable.
strategic_value: Seasonal imagery within a defined website concept can keep Helsinki current without losing consistency.
demonstration: Expanded webpage section: three bullets define selected color combinations, seasonal themes and everyday-life photography, followed by a registration-required documentation link.
practical_value: Use website-specific palettes and photography rules rather than assuming every brand option applies.

content_islands.name: Website-specific choices
content_islands.spec: Bullets describe accessible palette selections and seasonal changes.

content_islands.name: Imagery and detail source
content_islands.spec: The last bullet requires photographs for covers; a link points to fuller registered guidance.

reference_purposes.Constraint: The source says all cover images use photographs rather than illustrations.
